answers.explanation: Layer 5, the session layer, sits on layer 4, transport.
TCP/IP folds OSI layers 5, 6, and 7 into one application layer.
Presentation is about how data is represented: its format, encryption, and compression.
Establishing and terminating conversations is the session layer's core job.
A TLS library, for example, does presentation-layer work for a web browser.
Physical, Data link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.
